content.short: Argiefy tracks Argentine dollar, crypto and stablecoin rates to help people make better money decisions.
content.description: Argiefy is a personal finance tool for Argentina that shows live exchange rates for the official and blue dollar, USDT and other crypto, with calculators and guides. It runs a mini app inside World App, listed in World's ecosystem directory.
content.meta: Argiefy shows live Argentine dollar and stablecoin rates with calculators, and runs a World App mini app.
